issues.message: spec_lock typography-size recurrence: undeclared font-size 64 (3 occurrences) exceeds the sparse-display limit of 2 occurrences. Structural text must return to its declared role band; a genuinely recurring display treatment needs a justified named role in the Design Spec and spec_lock.

Noncanonical compact authoring: Visible text requires one direct root font-family default; semantic groups and text elements keep only real overrides (advisory; normalize with `python3 scripts/compact_svg_styles.py <svg_output> --inplace`, re-stamp pages that carry Chart/Table fallbacks, and rerun the final gate, or leave the explicit form)

Noncanonical compact authoring: Authoring SVG contains noncanonical or redundant inherited style declarations (8 change(s)); examples (group:attr None -> value hoists the shared value onto that group; child:attr value -> None drops the copy the child now inherits): svg[1]:font-family None -> 'Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif'; text[4]:font-family 'Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif' -> None; text[7]:font-family 'Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif' -> None (advisory; normalize with `python3 scripts/compact_svg_styles.py <svg_output> --inplace`, re-stamp pages that carry Chart/Table fallbacks, and rerun the final gate, or leave the explicit form)
